title: flext-infra: PROJECT_STATE_ROOT/scratch fica dentro da árvore git do superprojeto para membros (../.flext-runtime/<projeto>) — fuga de sandbox nos testes
description: Makefile.j2: PROJECT_STATE_ROOT := $(PROJECT_ROOT)/../.flext-runtime/$(notdir PROJECT_ROOT). Para um submódulo, o pai é o superprojeto → scratch do pytest (tmp_path) nasce dentro de flext/.flext-runtime/flext-infra/scratch, dentro da árvore git de flext; código sob teste que descobre a raiz git a partir de tmp_path empresta o superprojeto (ex. detector lê .gitmodules de flext e falha em test_root_config_sets_expected_execution_environments com 'subproject origin differs from its .gitmodules URL: flext-core'). Viola storage.md (scratch = home + tmp) e observable-runtime (teste escreve só em tmp_path sandbox). Relacionado: flext-bxo4y.
design: SSOT no flext-infra codegen (state_directory_name/scratch_namespace): ancorar o state root fora de qualquer árvore git (ex. $HOME/.flext-runtime/<workspace>/<projeto>, alinhado à decisão Q-A do ai-hub: stage em ~/tmp), regenerar Makefiles da frota; detector nunca sobe além da raiz do projeto sem .git próprio.
acceptance_criteria: Steps to Reproduce: cwd flext-infra; make test → FAILED tests/unit/deps/test_modernizer_pyright.py::…test_root_config_sets_expected_execution_environments ValueError subproject origin differs from its .gitmodules URL: flext-core. Acceptance Criteria: tmp_path do pytest fora de qualquer repositório git; teste verde; make gen ×2 sem diff na frota; storage.md satisfeito.
notes: Root cause precisa (X-20): ensure_pyright._expected_excludes → detector.analysis_exclusion_paths(tmp) → _git_origin_url → u.Infra.git_remote_url → gitpython Repo(resolved, search_parent_directories=True) (_git/repo.py:63; contrato documentado flext-infra-c3h para caminhos dentro de um checkout). tmp com .beads+.gitmodules mas sem .git 'empresta' o superprojeto. Fix no dono: analysis_exclusion_paths exige .git próprio (senão ungoverned → ok(())). Restante da bead: SSOT do scratch fora da árvore git (Makefile.j2 state_directory_name).

title: Protected-edit linting spawns subprocess storm per path x tool (test_rewrite_manual_typing_alias 27s > 10s timeout)
description:
tests/unit/codegen main+refactor suites time out: protected-edit linting spawns one subprocess per path x tool (mypy/ruff/pyrefly), 27s under load vs the 10s pytest-timeout budget.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Run make test in flext-infra on a loaded machine.
2. tests/unit/refactor/test_infra_refactor_namespace_moves.py::test_rewrite_manual_typing_alias_violations_uses_public_runtime_api exceeds pytest-timeout (10s), captured stack shows protected_edit_linting.lint_snapshots fan-out.

## Root Cause
lint_snapshots builds futures_by_path; each path runs every selected tool as its own process. N paths x M tools = N*M spawns; mypy cold start dominates.

## Fix Direction
Batch invocations: one process per TOOL receiving all snapshot paths (attribution via ruff/mypy path-prefixed output), preserving the LintSnapshot contract and cache keys.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] lint_snapshots spawns at most one process per selected tool per call.
- [ ] test_rewrite_manual_typing_alias_violations_uses_public_runtime_api passes within the 10s budget.
- [ ] make test green in flext-infra.
